decisions.reason: The request for publication-readiness guidance does not change the independently stated printed-cover design requirements; the cover-specific clauses already have their own Events.
Asking what front and back matter are needed does not revise or remove the existing publisher-attribution content on the copyright page.
The publication-guidance request does not change which client-edited manuscript revision or approved rewrites must be integrated.
The request for guidance about publication materials and steps does not alter the Chapter 12 subtitle, body-text hierarchy, or capitalization requirements.
Publication-readiness guidance does not modify the independent requirements to preserve chapter-image aspect ratios and avoid cropping.
The new request concerns publishing guidance rather than changing the manuscript's editorial objective or previously approved rewrites.
The general request to identify necessary front and back matter does not establish any new title-page content or change the existing title-formatting rule.
The publication-guidance request does not change chapter-image inclusion, selection, timing, or placement.
The request for front/back matter and publishing guidance does not alter the criteria or materials for reviewing chapter images for editorial fit.
